claim: The official obsidian CLI is desktop-app backed and includes file, search, daily, tag, template, and command surfaces.
obsidian-headless is an official npm Sync/Publish client, not a general note CRUD/search API.
The Local REST API community plugin is a desktop plugin exposing authenticated local HTTP(S) file/search/tag/command operations and a built-in MCP endpoint.
obsidian:// is an app action/deep-link scheme, not an authenticated data transport.
Do not use obsidian:// as the primary CRUD/MCP transport.
